name: Biocomposite Ultra High Density
filament_start_gcode: ; QZ biomaterial: cold extrusion, no filament-specific thermal ops
compatible_printers: QZmini @ Bambu Lab A1 mini 4.0 nozzle
QZmini @ Bambu Lab A1 mini 2.0 nozzle
filament_notes: Quasizero Biocomposite Ultra High Density v2 - recalibrated after the two-profile experiment (same paste printed identically through the Sawdust profile at flow 100%). CONCLUSION: the true volumetric ratio of this paste is ~1.0; the earlier 3.75/9.6 ratios were pressure-startup crutches that overcommanded the plunger (silently stalling TMC motor absorbed the excess) and corrupted E/ml accounting. Flow stays at 100% = geometric truth. Max volumetric speed 66 mm3/s = the hardware-validated deposition point (5 x 2.75 x 4.35 mm/s = 59.8) + 10%. Startup pressure is handled by procedure, not flow: purge at manual level 3 until a steady bead, and the process runs 2 skirt loops as pressurization laps. VERIFY on first use: the first skirt loop may under-extrude while pressure builds - that is expected and no reason to raise flow.
